title: Honeyed Shattering Slovakian Duck Legs Wrap
description: A festive and unique dish featuring sashimi-cut duck legs, honey, and traditional Slovakian flavors, all wrapped in a ti-leaf vessel.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together honey, paprika, caraway seeds, apple cider vinegar, and garlic. The mixture should be well combined and slightly thick.
Place the duck legs in a shallow dish and brush the honey mixture evenly over both legs.
Refrigerate the duck legs for at least 2 hours or overnight, allowing them to marinate in the sauce.
Remove the duck legs from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Place the duck legs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the duck legs are baking, toast the ti-leaf wraps by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
To assemble the wraps, place a duck leg in the center of each ti-leaf wrap, followed by a sprinkle of black pepper and any additional desired toppings.
Serve the Honeyed Shattering Slovakian Duck Legs Wrap immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
The duck legs should shatter easily when bitten into, releasing a burst of flavorful sauce.
Serve with additional ti-leaf wraps on the side for those who prefer to make their own wraps.
Enjoy the unique combination of flavors and textures in this Slovakian-inspired dish.
